limitations: Existing configurations and extra blocks were selected adaptively; all results are exploratory.
Pooled episode CP95 is descriptive: it is not a per-training-seed or simultaneous safety bound.
Per-seed bounds are nominal fixed-sample binomial bounds; selection over configurations is not covered.
Within-arm Bonferroni bounds cover its listed training seeds only, not configuration search.
Soft feasibility uses empirical episode mean, not a confidence guarantee or per-episode safety.
Learned feasibility scores and fallback argmin are not certified event probabilities.
Shared reset blocks support matched comparisons, not independent training-seed replication.
